response.content:
Here is a review of the bugs found in the code:

ISSUE: line 19 | The `get` method does not update the recency of the accessed key. It checks for the key and returns its value but fails to call `self.data.move_to_end(key)`, breaking the core LRU (Least Recently Used) eviction policy. Recently accessed items will not be promoted and could be evicted prematurely.

ISSUE: line 43 | The `hit_rate` method raises a `ZeroDivisionError` if called when the cache has recorded zero total accesses (`self.hits + self.misses == 0`).

ISSUE: line 59 | The `cached` decorator incorrectly checks for a cache miss by testing `if result is None`. If the function `fn` legitimately returns `None` for some arguments, it will be treated as a miss and the function will be re-executed on every subsequent call with those arguments, defeating the purpose of the cache. It should check against a unique sentinel object instead.
